items.en: Welcome to Shenzhen!
items.example: Welcome to our office!

items.en: How was your trip over?
items.example: How was your flight?

items.en: Did you have any trouble finding us?
items.example: Hope the traffic wasn't too bad.

items.en: I'll be showing you around today.
items.example: I'll be your host today.

items.en: This way, please.
items.example: Right this way.

items.zh: 要喝点什么吗？咖啡还是茶？
items.en: Can I get you something to drink? Coffee or tea?
items.example: Would you like some water?

items.en: Please have a seat and make yourself comfortable.
items.example: Please, take a seat.

items.en: Let's head to the meeting room first.
items.example: Let's head upstairs first.

items.zh: 我跟您说一下今天的安排。
items.en: Let me walk you through today's schedule.
items.example: Here's the plan for today.

items.zh: 我们先简单介绍公司，然后去展厅。
items.en: We'll start with a quick overview, then visit the showroom.
items.example: We'll start with a short intro, then have lunch.

items.en: It'll take about an hour and a half.
items.example: It should take about an hour.

items.zh: 有什么需要随时跟我说。
items.en: Just let me know if you need anything.
items.example: Feel free to ask me anything.

items.en: The restroom is at the end of the hall.
items.example: The restroom is just around the corner.

items.zh: 这是您第一次来中国吗？
items.en: Is this your first time in China?
items.example: Have you been to Shenzhen before?

items.en: Are you over the jet lag yet?
items.example: Did you manage to get some sleep?

items.en: What are you working on these days?
items.example: What's keeping you busy these days?

items.zh: 最近挺忙的，在准备一个新品上市。
items.en: It's been busy. We're getting ready for a product launch.
items.example: We're rushing to meet a deadline.

items.en: How's the project going?
items.example: How's everything on your end?

items.en: It's going pretty well so far.
items.example: So far, so good.

items.zh: 我们进度稍微有点落后。
items.en: We're a little behind schedule.
items.example: We're right on schedule.

items.en: I've been in meetings all week.
items.example: I've been in back-to-back meetings.

items.en: How long have you been with the company?
items.example: How long have you been on this team?

items.en: I've been here for almost three years.
items.example: I joined about two years ago.

items.en: I mainly work on product planning.
items.example: I mostly handle product requirements.

items.zh: 我经常和研发团队打交道。
items.en: I work closely with the R&D team.
items.example: I work closely with the sales team.

items.zh: 过了这周应该会轻松一点。
items.en: Things should calm down after this week.
items.example: I can finally catch my breath on Friday.

items.en: Want to grab lunch together?
items.example: Want to grab a coffee?

items.en: How big is your team?
items.example: How many people are on your team?

items.zh: 我们团队大概二十个人。
items.en: There are about twenty people on our team.
items.example: We're a small team of eight.

items.zh: 你们团队主要负责哪块？
items.en: What does your team mainly focus on?
items.example: What's your team working on right now?

items.zh: 我先简单介绍一下我们公司。
items.en: Let me give you a quick intro to our company.
items.example: Let me start with a quick overview.

items.zh: 我们公司成立于 2010 年。
items.en: We were founded in 2010.
items.example: The company started about fifteen years ago.

items.en: We're headquartered in Shenzhen.
items.example: Our head office is here in Shenzhen.

items.zh: 我们全球大概有两千名员工。
items.en: We have around 2,000 employees worldwide.
items.example: About a third of them work in R&D.

items.zh: 我们主要做智能硬件和配套的软件。
items.en: We mainly make smart devices and the software that runs them.
items.example: We focus on smart hardware and software.

items.zh: 我们的产品卖到五十多个国家。
items.en: Our products are sold in over fifty countries.
items.example: We have customers in over thirty countries.

items.zh: 我们的客户大多是经销商和集成商。
items.en: Most of our customers are distributors and system integrators.
items.example: Most of our clients are in retail.

items.zh: 研发和生产都是我们自己做的。
items.en: We do our own R&D and manufacturing.
items.example: We handle everything in-house.

items.zh: 我们在海外有好几个办事处。
items.en: We have several offices overseas.
items.example: We also have an office in Dubai.

items.zh: 这是我们增长最快的业务。
items.en: This is our fastest-growing business.
items.example: This is our core business.

items.zh: 我们非常重视产品质量。
items.en: We take product quality very seriously.
items.example: Quality is our top priority.

items.zh: 这些是和我们合作过的一些客户。
items.en: These are some of the clients we've worked with.
items.example: Here are a few of our partners.

items.zh: 这页是我们的全球布局。
items.en: This slide shows where we are around the world.
items.example: This map shows our global presence.

items.en: Any questions so far?
items.example: Does that make sense so far?

items.zh: 接下来我带您去看看产品。
items.en: Next, I'll show you our products.
items.example: Now let's move on to the products.

items.en: This is our showroom.
items.example: Welcome to our showroom.

items.en: Let me give you a quick demo.
items.example: Let me show you how it works.

items.en: This is our latest product.
items.example: This is our newest model.

items.zh: 它主要用在商场和写字楼。
items.en: It's mainly used in shopping malls and office buildings.
items.example: It's mainly used in schools and hospitals.

items.zh: 它最大的卖点是安装简单。
items.en: Its biggest selling point is that it's easy to install.
items.example: What makes it stand out is the price.

items.zh: 用手机 App 就能控制。
items.en: You can control it with our phone app.
items.example: You can manage everything from the app.

items.zh: 所有设备都能在一个平台上管理。
items.en: You can manage all your devices on one platform.
items.example: Everything shows up on one dashboard.

items.zh: 它比上一代小了三分之一。
items.en: It's a third smaller than the last model.
items.example: It's twice as fast as the old version.

items.en: This model is our best seller.
items.example: This one's really popular in Europe.

items.en: Feel free to try it yourself.
items.example: Go ahead and give it a try.

items.zh: 它可以和第三方系统对接。
items.en: It works with third-party systems.
items.example: It works with most existing systems.

items.zh: 我们也可以根据需求定制。
items.en: We can also customize it for your needs.
items.example: We can adjust it based on your requirements.

items.en: It comes with a two-year warranty.
items.example: We also offer local after-sales support.

items.zh: 这个我得跟技术同事确认一下。
items.en: Let me check with our tech team on that.
items.example: I'll need to double-check that with our engineers.

items.en: I'll send you the details after the meeting.
items.example: I'll email you the spec sheet later.

items.en: Thanks for stopping by our booth!
items.example: Welcome to our booth!

items.en: What kind of products are you looking for?
items.example: Is there anything in particular you're interested in?

items.en: What line of business are you in?
items.example: What does your company do?

items.en: Which company are you with?
items.example: Where are you visiting from?

items.en: Can I add you on LinkedIn?
items.example: Are you on WhatsApp?

items.en: Could we swap contact details?
items.example: Can I get your email?

items.en: Let's follow up by email.
items.example: I'll follow up with you next week.

items.zh: 扫这个二维码就能看产品目录。
items.en: Just scan this QR code for our catalog.
items.example: You can scan this code for more details.

items.en: Here's our product brochure.
items.example: Feel free to take a brochure.

items.en: There's a great turnout this year.
items.example: The show is really busy this year.

items.zh: 我昨天刚到，还在倒时差。
items.en: I just flew in yesterday, so I'm still jet-lagged.
items.example: I got in late last night.

items.zh: 我的航班晚点了两个小时。
items.en: My flight was delayed by two hours.
items.example: My flight got in right on time.

items.zh: 我住在展馆附近的酒店。
items.en: I'm staying at a hotel near the venue.
items.example: I'm staying just across the street.

items.en: We'll be here until Friday.
items.example: We're flying back on Saturday.

items.zh: 有机会来深圳，欢迎来我们公司看看。
items.en: If you're ever in Shenzhen, come visit our office.
items.example: You're welcome to visit us anytime.

items.en: Today's meeting was really productive.
items.example: This has been really helpful.

items.zh: 我总结一下今天聊的内容。
items.en: Let me sum up what we discussed today.
items.example: Let me quickly recap.

items.en: Here are the next steps.
items.example: Here's how we'll move forward.

items.zh: 我们下周前把报价发给您。
items.en: We'll send you a quote by next week.
items.example: We'll get back to you by Friday.

items.en: Delivery usually takes about four weeks.
items.example: Lead time is usually about a month.

items.en: Do you have any other concerns?
items.example: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

items.zh: 我们约个视频会议接着聊吧。
items.en: Let's set up a video call to follow up.
items.example: Let's schedule a follow-up call.

items.en: Does next Tuesday work for you?
items.example: Does that time work for you?

items.en: Thanks for coming all the way here today.
items.example: Thank you for taking the time to visit.

items.en: I've booked a car for you.
items.example: Your car is waiting downstairs.

items.en: I'll walk you out.
items.example: Let me walk you downstairs.

items.en: Have a safe trip back.
items.example: Safe travels!

items.en: We look forward to working with you.
items.example: I'm looking forward to working together.

items.en: Drop me a message when you land.
items.example: Let me know when you get there.

items.en: Feel free to reach out if you have any questions.
items.example: Don't hesitate to reach out anytime.

scenes.title: 迎接来访客户
scenes.persona: David, a friendly purchasing manager from a distributor in Berlin, visiting your company in Shenzhen for the first time. He has just arrived at the front desk after a long flight.
scenes.opening: Hi, I'm David from Berlin. I have a meeting here at ten.
scenes.opening_zh: 你好，我是柏林来的 David，十点在这里有个会。
scenes.brief: 德国经销商的客户 David 第一次来公司拜访，你到前台接他。

tasks.check: the learner welcomes David and introduces themself

tasks.zh: 问问他路上是否顺利或时差
tasks.check: the learner asks about his trip, his flight, finding the office, or jet lag
the learner offers David something to drink
the learner explains the plan or schedule for the visit

hints.zh: 欢迎来深圳！今天由我来接待您。
hints.en: Welcome to Shenzhen! I'll be showing you around today.

hints.zh: 要喝点什么吗？咖啡还是茶？
hints.en: Can I get you something to drink? Coffee or tea?

hints.zh: 我们先简单介绍公司，然后去展厅。
hints.en: We'll start with a quick overview, then visit the showroom.

scenes.title: 午饭聊聊工作
scenes.persona: Daniel, a friendly British colleague who joined the overseas sales team a month ago, chatting with you over lunch in the company cafeteria
scenes.opening: Hey, mind if I join you? How's your week going?
scenes.opening_zh: 嘿，介意我坐这儿吗？你这周过得怎么样？
scenes.brief: 午饭时，刚加入海外销售团队的外籍同事 Daniel 坐到你旁边，聊聊工作。

tasks.zh: 说说你这周忙不忙、在忙什么
tasks.check: the learner says how busy their week is or what they are working on
the learner explains their own role or what they are responsible for
the learner asks Daniel how he is settling in or how his new job is going
match: how('s| is) (the new job|your new|everything|it going)

tasks.zh: 约他之后一起喝咖啡或吃饭
tasks.check: the learner suggests getting coffee or lunch together again

hints.zh: 最近挺忙的，在准备一个新品上市。
hints.en: It's been busy. We're getting ready for a product launch.
I mainly work on product planning.

scenes.title: 会议室里介绍公司
scenes.persona: Sophie, a business development manager from a system integrator in Singapore, sitting in your meeting room at the start of her visit. She is curious and asks short follow-up questions about the company.
scenes.opening: Thanks for having me. So, could you tell me a bit about your company?
scenes.opening_zh: 谢谢你们的接待。那你能先介绍一下你们公司吗？
scenes.brief: 会议室里，新加坡集成商的客户 Sophie 请你先介绍一下公司。

tasks.zh: 说说公司成立时间或总部在哪
tasks.check: the learner says when the company was founded or where it is headquartered
the learner explains what products or business the company mainly does

tasks.zh: 说说公司规模或市场（员工、国家、客户）
tasks.check: the learner mentions the company's size, markets, countries or main customers
the learner asks Sophie if she has any questions

hints.zh: 我先简单介绍一下我们公司。
hints.en: Let me give you a quick intro to our company.

hints.zh: 我们主要做智能硬件和配套的软件。
hints.en: We mainly make smart devices and the software that runs them.

scenes.title: 展厅讲解产品
scenes.persona: Ahmed, a practical distributor from Dubai who cares about price, installation and after-sales support. He asks direct questions while the learner shows him around the showroom. After two or three turns, ask one detailed technical question the learner probably can't answer on the spot, such as the exact power consumption or the warranty terms in the UAE.
scenes.opening: Nice showroom! So, which product would you recommend for shopping malls?
scenes.opening_zh: 展厅不错！那你们有什么适合商场的产品推荐吗？
scenes.brief: 你带迪拜的经销商 Ahmed 参观展厅，他想找适合商场用的产品。

tasks.zh: 推荐一款产品，说说用在哪里
tasks.check: the learner recommends a product and says where it is used

tasks.zh: 说出它的一个主要卖点
tasks.check: the learner mentions a key selling point or advantage of the product

tasks.zh: 说明怎么控制或管理（App、平台）
tasks.check: the learner explains how the product is controlled or managed, such as an app or a platform

tasks.zh: 答不上的问题，说会确认后回复
tasks.check: the learner says they will check with the team or get back to him later

hints.zh: 这个型号卖得最好，主要用在商场和写字楼。
hints.en: This model is our best seller. It's mainly used in shopping malls and office buildings.

hints.zh: 它最大的卖点是安装简单。
hints.en: Its biggest selling point is that it's easy to install.

hints.zh: 这个我得跟技术同事确认一下。
hints.en: Let me check with our tech team on that.

scenes.title: 展会展位接待
scenes.persona: Maria, a buyer from a retail chain in Spain, walking past the learner's booth at a busy international trade show. She is interested but a little short on time.
scenes.opening: Hi there! What's this device here? I've seen a few like it today.
scenes.opening_zh: 你好！这个设备是什么？我今天看到好几个类似的了。
scenes.brief: 在国际展会的展位上，一位西班牙零售连锁的采购 Maria 走过来问产品。

tasks.zh: 了解她在找什么、做什么业务
tasks.check: the learner asks what she is looking for or what her business does
the learner briefly introduces the product
the learner offers a business card or asks for contact details
the learner suggests following up after the show

hints.en: What kind of products are you looking for?

hints.zh: 这是我的名片。能留个联系方式吗？
hints.en: Here's my card. Could we swap contact details?

scenes.title: 挑战：送别客户、约定下一步
scenes.persona: David, a purchasing manager from a distributor in Berlin, at the end of a half-day visit to the learner's company in Shenzhen. He has seen the showroom and liked it. He asks one practical question about delivery time, then gets ready to leave for the airport.
scenes.opening: Thanks, that was a great tour. Before I go, how long does delivery usually take?
scenes.opening_zh: 谢谢，参观得很有收获。走之前问一下，交货一般要多久？
scenes.brief: David 参观完准备离开。回答他最后一个问题，总结今天的内容，约定下一步，再送他离开。

tasks.zh: 回答交货期（不确定就说会确认）
tasks.check: the learner answers about delivery time or says they will confirm it
the learner sums up what was discussed during the visit

tasks.zh: 说明下一步（报价、资料等）
tasks.check: the learner explains the next steps, such as sending a quote or materials
the learner suggests a follow-up call or meeting
the learner actually says goodbye, e.g. wishing him a safe trip

hints.zh: 我总结一下今天聊的内容。
hints.en: Let me sum up what we discussed today.

hints.zh: 我们下周前把报价发给您。
hints.en: We'll send you a quote by next week.

hints.zh: 感谢您今天专程过来，祝您回程顺利。
hints.en: Thanks for coming all the way here today. Have a safe trip back.
